# Binary asset note

This document describes how image assets are inlined into generated
reports. The pipeline reads the raw file, base64-encodes the payload, and
embeds it in the output so no separate file fetch is needed. For example,
the first 1900 bytes of a PNG-style chunk stream (header plus IDAT data)
encode to:



Decoding that blob yields the original binary bytes: control octets in the
0x00-0x07 range are normal inside PNG chunk structures, the DEL byte 0x7f
appears in compressed data, and embedded identifier strings such as the
word "bash" occur inside the payload. This is documentation prose only; no
shell command is present anywhere in this file.
